notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.content:
Improved Polish translation thanks to Prawie for the help.
Also improved UI scaling, making text more readable and less overlapped.

notes.title: UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT + NEW DLCs
notes.content:
As mentioned in a previous post, I am planing in adding late game features, such as, auto collection, more money per recipe, and a few other interesting mechanics. If you have any suggestions I would love to hear them, you can post them as comments. At the moment you can wishlist 3 new DLCs that will for sure add even more crazy combinations for your customers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303270/Blacksmith_Weapon_Merchant__Demons_DLC/?curator_clanid=40493198

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303272/Blacksmith_Weapon_Merchant__Magicians_DLC/?curator_clanid=40493198

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303271/Blacksmith_Weapon_Merchant__Angels_DLC/?curator_clanid=40493198

Note that all DLCs are compatible with each other, with that I mean that, customers will appear with mixed aspects of each DLC you have. They may have eyes from one, the mouth from another, and so on. So the more DLCs you have, the more possible combinations, thus more unique customers will appear.

Ohh, and don't forget to wishlist my upcoming idler clicker game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285820/Idling_Gears/?curator_clanid=40493198

Enjoy!

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: Small update that adds the capability to see the high score leaderboard while the game is still going on (recommended when your score is high and you can spend a few seconds without collecting any resources)

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Fixed long loading of 100K+ score save files.
Fixed a minor bug with the volume of some sounds.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Small update that corrects a small visual bug.

Plus new feature intended for the late game. You can now hold the right mouse button to collect resources instead of clicking them one by one.

notes.title: NEW SAVING FEATURE!
notes.content:
As requested by some of you, I have added a saving feature.

Once you start a game, you will see a "save" icon on the top left of your screen. You can click on it or press the "G" on your keyboard to save the current game. There is an autosave implemented that will save the game every 5 seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723896/60cbe9c71d818984d0c5f55de8063981f4fb56a6.png[/img]

Once the game is saved, you can close the game. The next time you open the "save" icon will appear next to "PLAY". That means there is a saved game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723896/aacb96fee18fa968ec5492b24986515730b2d3fd.png[/img]

In case you want to start over, you can click over the "save" icon and that will delete it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723896/2f553099888497fff6b3ae003c61e7c8d378e84d.png[/img]

The saved game will be synced with Steam Cloud so you can get back where you were from any PC.

notes.title: Quality of Live improvements
notes.content:
Added the capability to buy upgrades using the number row. 
1 will buy "Faster pickup" 2 "Faster growth" and so on. To buy extra lives you can press space.
